status: DRAFT after challenger R1 (not registered; sha256 not pinned; census values, strata, family exclusions and k not filled)
k_tests_rule: list of the primaries that survived their census gates (LIVE_TESTS_4.md section 8), fixed before the pin; Holm m = len(k_tests); null = not filled (a pinned spec with null k_tests is refused)
code_sha_rule: normalised module sha256 (the SPEC_SHA256 line excluded); frozen lines carry code_sha = first 16 hex of sha256(h(live_tests4.py) + h(live_tests3.py)) (LIVE_TESTS_4.md 1.0 L7)

eligibility.rule: section 1.4: binary, not closed, active, two-sided (0 < bid < ask <= 1) and spread <= 0.10 (Gamma spread, else ask - bid) at k-1 and k; one row per market_id and per condition_id (first in page order)

sports_rule: cb17_census.is_sports_sidecar(fee_type, fee_category, series_slugs) on the sidecar of the capture; sidecar missing -> sports = -1 (unknown; excluded wherever the category is needed)

crypto_rule.rule: crypto = fee_type starts with 'crypto' or the first series slug matches slug_regex (section 13, finding 2)

series_key_rule: first series slug if present, else 'event:' + event_id; crypto rows without a slug -> 'crypto:noslug' (one family: one spot driver)

move.class_rule: never_traded (ltp absent at k-1 and k) > traded (L or V+) > ambiguous (V-, ltp present at k-1 and absent at k, or volume24hr unknown) > quote_only (not L, V0); geometry for every unit: parallel (sign db = sign da = sign x, both >= 0.005, |db - da| <= 0.005), one_sided (min(|db|,|da|) <= 0.0005), spread_change (opposite signs, both > 0.0005), same_side_unequal (rest)

e020.rule: one-sided quote-only |x| >= 1c movers, tick known and equal at k-1 and k; arrival = quoted spread narrowed by > 1e-9, cancellation = widened by > 1e-9; U = the unmoved side; r = sign(x)(U_{k+1} - U_k); primary on common support: both quoted spreads >= 3 ticks and <= 0.10 (R1 finding 1); full population a sensitivity

e021.rule: traded |x| >= 1c movers in the pass's active sample; age = t_k - newest page row with ts < t_k; fresh <= 900 s, settled >= 3600 s; age > 9000 s -> clock_inconsistent; no pre-origin row -> unclocked_truncated (page full) or unclocked_no_prior
e021.target: c_skip = sign(x)(mid_{k+3} - mid_{k+1}) (R1 finding 3); the 2 h c is mechanism reading M2; n2h_truncated units excluded

hollow.rule: D = depth_bid_5c * sbid + depth_ask_5c * sask (sweep 1 of pass k, outcome-0 token); L = Gamma liquidity at capture k; h = clip(1 - D / L, 0, 1); zh = (h - centre) / scale (census)
hollow.depth_def_rule: fixed by census CH before the pin (R1 finding 6): 'both' (outcome-0 + outcome-1 token 5c depth) if L >= D_both in >= 90% of covered non-sports books, else 'token0' if L >= D_token0 in >= 90%, else E022 is dropped

flow.walk_rule: a signed row is walked if the sidecar tick at the sample's capture is known and |p - tick * round(p / tick)| >= 1e-4 (section 13, finding 4); tick unknown -> the row is left out of W (numerator and denominator)
flow.categories: all (sports reported split; category is a parameter)

size_check.rule: rejection rate of each binding gate scenario under its simulated null <= 0.05 + 1.645 sqrt(0.05 x 0.95 / worlds); eleven scenarios, ten binding (donor_correlated_moderator0.7 reported only: the census caps the correlation at 0.5); the scenarios use the registered gates (Freedman-Lane; residualised donor) (LIVE_TESTS_4.md 14.5); run on the code to be pinned

gates.perm_method: Freedman-Lane (reduced-model residuals permuted within strata) for E020-E022; residualised-moderator distant-donor gate (LT4 donor_gate_resid) for E023/E024
gates.perm_stratum_rule: market x UTC day if the census share of units in strata with >= 4 units is >= 50%, else market x two-day block if that share is >= 50%, else the test is dropped (R1 finding 2)

CQ_E020.de_rule: DE = 1 + (m_21 - 1) x rho, m = sum n_e^2 / sum n_e of the census population by event, m_21 = m x 21 / census days (R1 finding 8)

CF_E021.de_rule: DE = 1 + (m_21 - 1) x rho, m = sum n_e^2 / sum n_e of the census population by event, m_21 = m x 21 / census days (R1 finding 8)

mde_assumptions.rule: t_sum x sd / sqrt(projected effective units) x sqrt(census DE) x day x sqrt(within-market VIF of zh) x tercile gap <= 0.5c

CH_E022.de_rule: DE = 1 + (m_21 - 1) x rho, m = sum n_e^2 / sum n_e of the census population by event, m_21 = m x 21 / census days (R1 finding 8)
CH_E022.rule_resid_iqr: within each market with >= 10 covered units, IQR of the residual of h after an OLS on log1p D_{k-1} >= 0.05 in >= 50% of such markets, and >= 30 such markets (R1 finding 4)

CF_E023.mde_rule: 0.002873 x sqrt(5,000 / projected events) x sqrt(VIF of x6*zOP on the model's other x6 terms after expanding-past demeaning) <= 0.0036 (R1 finding 9)
CF_E023.corr_controlled_rule: max |corr| of the tested moderator with W, H, log N, log Size, spread, log RV, log hours-to-end <= corr_max (0.5): the donor gate is size-checked only up to 0.5 (R1 finding 7)

CF_E024.corr_controlled_rule: max |corr| of the tested moderator with W, H, log N, log Size, spread, log RV, log hours-to-end <= corr_max (0.5): the donor gate is size-checked only up to 0.5 (R1 finding 7)

census_inputs.CQ_CH_seal: docs/research_lab/seals/lt4_census_inputs_captures.json (to be written from the releases' files.sha256 before any LT4 census runs)
census_inputs.projection: counts x 21 / census days (estimate); distinct events: E_2d + (E_2d - E_day1) x 19; effective = units in markets with >= 2 units of the population
census_inputs.CQ_CH_sweeps: sweep 1 of every census pass and of slot k - 1 (E022's depth control)
